findings_addressed.oracle: The production injection_monitor.ps1 write_injection_record format (pipe-delimited: timestamp|src_pid|src_name|inj_pid|inj_name|inj_type|api_calls) as the independent oracle; the inj_type field (index 5) is asserted to never equal the string shellcode_injection. The asserting test now requires a non-empty all_records list before iterating, eliminating the vacuous path.

The production script's outer catch block (lines 490-497 of injection_monitor.ps1) unconditionally calls throw after writing the trace_session_failed diagnostic, guaranteeing a non-zero exit on any session failure. The outer catch also calls Write-InjectionDiagnostic before throwing, guaranteeing the diag file is created. On the TraceEvent-missing path (lines 127-134) the diag file is also written before throw. Either path guarantees: (a) returncode != 0, (b) diag file exists, (c) at least one timestamp|category|detail record in the diag file.
